subject: POC trial planning: success criteria & RACI for HorizonCare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandeep Reddy <sandeep.reddy@horizoncare.org>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@horizoncare.org>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC recap + proposed success criteria / owners (HorizonCare)

Hi Sandeep —

Thanks again for the call today. Wanted to capture the key outcomes and proposed next steps so we can align on owners and timeline for the trial. Please review and confirm/comment.

Objective: run a 2-week POC that validates Redwood can meet HorizonCare requirements for latency, cost, and data isolation for a pilot set of clinician-facing summarization flows.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 450ms for average 512-token requests under expected concurrency (10 concurrent clinicians).
- Quality: Clinician accept rate >= 85% on a 50-sample blind eval vs current baseline (we'll provide eval set).
- Cost: Token cost reduction of >= 30% vs current hosted provider for the same throughput profile.
- Security: All traffic stays within your VPC; audit logs enabled and retained for 90 days.

Evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (kickoff): infra access, test dataset exchange, run baseline with current provider.
- Weeks 1–2: Redwood trial with dedicated capacity; daily token/latency dashboards, weekly check-in.
- Week 3: Final validation, blind quality eval, review & decision.

Proposed ownership (please confirm or update):
- HorizonCare infra owner (VPC, networking): Rohit Gupta <rohit.gupta@horizoncare.org> (you mentioned Rohit on the call)
- HorizonCare app/product owner: Priya Menon <priya.menon@horizoncare.org>
- HorizonCare procurement lead: Sandeep Reddy <sandeep.reddy@horizoncare.org>
- Redwood POC lead (config, routing, evaluation): Marissa Cole (me)
- Redwood infra/ops support: Aditya Rao (kernel/runtime tuning, sizing)
- Redwood success/quality contact: Lauren Bishop (eval design, metrics)

Attachments: I have a one-page POC SOW and a starter RACI spreadsheet I can send once we align on owners.

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm owners above (Rohit/Priya/Sandeep) and procurement timing (when can we sign the SOW?).
2) Share a sample dataset (PII redacted) and any networking constraints (eg. allowed egress IPs).
3) Confirm ideal kickoff dates — we suggested 8/24 for kickoff and 8/25 start of trial week 1. Is that workable?

If helpful I can drop a short SOW and a filled RACI; attached would be the next step.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sandeep Reddy <sandeep.reddy@horizoncare.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@horizoncare.org>, Rohit Gupta <rohit.gupta@horizoncare.org>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed success criteria / owners (HorizonCare)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming owners below:
- Rohit will own infra (VPC, firewall rules, IP allowlist) — Rohit, I'll loop you for details.
- Priya will own application acceptance criteria and provide the eval dataset.
- I will own procurement and sign-off (timeline below).

Procurement timeline: we can review SOW this week; procurement needs a 5–7 business day review once the SOW is in our DocuSign system. If you send SOW by EOD Friday (8/14), we should be able to execute by 8/24 which fits your kickoff target.

Rohit — can you confirm whether your infra team can open the required egress to the IPs you sent previously, and whether you need a peered VPC or IP allowlist?

Priya — can you share the 50-sample eval set (PII redacted) by Friday? We will prioritize the acceptance eval.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

—Sandeep
Sandeep Reddy
Director, Digital Platforms
HorizonCare
sandeep.reddy@horizoncare.org

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandeep Reddy <sandeep.reddy@horizoncare.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@horizoncare.org>, Rohit Gupta <rohit.gupta@horizoncare.org>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed success criteria / owners (HorizonCare)

Thanks Sandeep — quick note from the evaluation side.

We'll own the blind quality eval setup and provide the evaluation harness:
- Redwood will run a blind A/B of 50 samples vs your baseline; we'll redact any PII before sharing results.
- We'll instrument the trial with these telemetry hooks: per-request latency, token counts, error rates, and per-sample accept/reject flags.
- Weekly check-ins: Wed 9am PT (we propose 8/26 for first check-in).

I've attached a starter RACI (POC_RACI_HorizonCare.xlsx) with our suggested owner assignments filled in. Please update and return.

Redwood commitments during trial:
- Dedicated trial capacity with isolation from other tenants.
- Daily dashboards and an assistant to review any quality regressions.
- Work with Rohit on network peering/allowlist during Week 0.

If Rohit can confirm network approach and Priya can share the eval set by EOD Friday we can proceed with the SOW sign timeline Sandeep outlined.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success (Trials)
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Marissa / Lauren —

We can confirm Rohit will handle the network allowlist. Rohit: please share IPs and whether you prefer VPC peering or allowlist.

Priya will send the 50-sample eval set by EOD Friday.

One ask from procurement: can you attach the SOW and provide the company payment details (tax ID, billing contact) so we can route the SOW quickly through DocuSign? If possible, send as PDF.

Thanks — will review the attached RACI and update if needed.

—Sandeep
